items.title: OneFlip: An Emerging Threat to AI that Could Make Vehicles Crash and Facial Recognition Fail
items.description: Researchers unveil OneFlip, a Rowhammer-based attack that flips a single bit in neural network weights to stealthily backdoor AI systems without degrading performance. The post OneFlip: An Emerging Threat to AI that Could Make Vehicles Crash and Facial Recognition Fail appeared first on SecurityWeek.
